name: Shuuchizuma Chijoku Densha ~M no Kakusei ni Tomadoi Ochiru Kouhai no Ane-san Nyoubou~
original_name: 羞恥妻痴辱電車～Mの覚醒に戸惑い堕ちる後輩の姉さん女房～
source: 30-year-old Keiji Joujima is a prolific molester who habitually targets women in the train.  He sets his sights on Reika, a 29-year old housewife whose six-year-long marriage is beginning to go stale.  Reika's husband is completely unenthusiastic about sex and she is beginning to worry that she is no longer attractive, but when she meets Keiji, her masochistic and exhibitionist tendencies begin to emerge.
translation: 30岁的城岛启司是惯于在电车里对女性下手的痴汉。这次，他盯上了29岁的家庭主妇神山怜香。怜香的婚姻已经维持六年，却逐渐失去激情。丈夫对性生活毫无兴致，她也开始担心自己是不是已经不再有魅力。然而遇见启司后，她潜藏的受虐欲与暴露癖开始渐渐觉醒。
